context_length: Trained on sequences of up to 512 tokens, with T5 relative position bias; longer sequences are embedded whole here
summary: The XL Ankh3 model: the largest Ankh3 variant, with 2560-dim embeddings, trained with the same span denoising and sequence completion recipe.
architecture: T5 encoder-decoder with 48 encoder and 24 decoder layers. Only the encoder is used here (3.48B parameters), giving 2560-dim per-residue embeddings. A task prefix, [NLU] for denoising or [S2S] for completion, selects the objective.
pretraining_data: 59.1M sequences from UniRef50, trained with T5x (JAX) on 64 TPUv4 chips.
pretraining_objective: Two objectives, one drawn per sequence: span denoising with 15, 20 or 30% of residues masked by sentinel tokens, and sequence completion, where the encoder reads the first part of a sequence and the decoder generates the rest.
key_innovations: Largest Ankh3 variant, with the highest embedding dimension (2560) in this benchmark's Ankh line
Its paper finds the completion prefix [S2S] better than [NLU] on GB1 and fluorescence, and calls the best prefix task-dependent
when_to_use: When you want the largest Ankh3 and can afford 2560-dim embeddings.
caveats: 2025 preprint; weights under CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 (non-commercial). The 2560-dim embeddings make downstream heads more expensive. Sequences were embedded here without a task prefix; the model card prepends [NLU], and the paper evaluates both [NLU] and [S2S], so these embeddings differ from the authors' setting.
